subject: PickAPlugin started from your list
text:
Hi HOL team,

A lot of PickAPlugin's catalog started from your awesome-codex-plugins list, so thanks for keeping it going. We just put out open data on 339 Codex plugin repos (licenses, install commands, plugin.json checks) and it's free to reuse under CC BY: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

If you think it fits under Guides & Articles I'd be glad to see it there, and I can open a PR instead if that's easier for you. HOL Guard is listed with us too at https://pickaplugin.com/p/hol-guard-plugin, and there's a free README badge on that page if you ever want one.

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Your MCP shortlist + our Codex plugin data
text:
Hi,

Really liked your MCP install shortlist, the 19 out of 101 framing makes it easy to act on. We did a similar pull on 339 Codex plugin repos and found 145 READMEs mention an API key or token and 61 wire up a remote MCP server over HTTP. It's all CC BY, so feel free to cite it in a future post: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

Happy to link your audit board from our side too if that sounds good.

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Codex plugin data for a future issue
text:
Hi,

Saw AgentAtlas Weekly covers Codex and the repos people are building around it, so this might be handy for an issue. We pulled GitHub data on 339 open-source Codex plugin repos: 97% were created this year, the median one has 6 stars, and 105 have no copyable install command in the README. Free to cite with a link: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Open data on 339 Codex plugins
text:
Hi,

I like that every fact on Agentic Weekly links back to a source, so here's one you can link to if it's useful. We checked 339 open-source ChatGPT and Codex plugin repos and wrote up what came back, like 79% being MIT and only 3 of 274 plugin.json files having a hard error. It's CC BY and free to cite: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Your Codex plugins review
text:
Hi Mejba,

Read your Codex plugins write-up and the part where you pulled apart the manifest files was my favorite bit. We checked 274 plugin.json files across 339 community plugin repos and only 3 had a hard error, which honestly surprised us. If you ever update the post the data is free to cite with a link: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026 and there's a free plugin.json validator at https://pickaplugin.com/tools/plugin-json-validator if it's useful for readers.

Aaron, PickAPlugin
